overzichtModel.query: FROM (SELECT * FROM creche_reservering AS f :f.where) AS f JOIN klanten AS k ON f.klant_id = k.klant_id JOIN creche_reservering_regels AS r ON f.creche_reservering_id = r.creche_reservering_id JOIN dieren AS dier ON r.dier_id = dier.dier_id JOIN rassen AS ras ON dier.ras_id = ras.ras_id JOIN diersoort AS soort ON ras.diersoort_id = soort.diersoort_id

veld.naam: (SELECT kleur.naam FROM kleur_codes AS kleur WHERE kleur.kleur_code_id = k.kleur_code_id)
veld.label: Kleurcode

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(d.naam ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM creche_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id WHERE (r.creche_reservering_id = f.creche_reservering_id))
veld.label: Dier(en)

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(soort.naam ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM creche_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id LEFT JOIN rassen AS ras ON d.ras_id = ras.ras_id LEFT JOIN diersoort AS soort ON ras.diersoort_id = soort.diersoort_id WHERE (r.creche_reservering_id = f.creche_reservering_id))
veld.label: Diersoort(en)

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(concat(ras.naam,IF(d.kruising,' (kr.)','')) ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM creche_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id LEFT JOIN rassen AS ras ON d.ras_id = ras.ras_id WHERE (r.creche_reservering_id = f.creche_reservering_id))
veld.label: Ras(sen)

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(IF(d.geslacht = 'Mannelijk','M',IF(d.geslacht = 'Vrouwelijk','V','?')) ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM creche_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id WHERE (r.creche_reservering_id = f.creche_reservering_id))
veld.label: Geslacht

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(IF(d.gecastreerd,'Ja','Nee') ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM creche_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id WHERE (r.creche_reservering_id = f.creche_reservering_id))
veld.label: Gecastreerd

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(d.kleur ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM creche_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id WHERE (r.creche_reservering_id = f.creche_reservering_id))
veld.label: Kleur

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat((IF(d.`geboortedatum` IS NULL,'',CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(IF(MONTH(NOW())>MONTH(d.`geboortedatum`),YEAR(NOW())-YEAR(d.`geboortedatum`),IF(MONTH(NOW())=MONTH(d.`geboortedatum`) AND DAYOFMONTH(NOW())>DAYOFMONTH(d.`geboortedatum`),YEAR(NOW())-YEAR(d.`geboortedatum`),YEAR(NOW())-YEAR(d.`geboortedatum`)-1)),'jr. '),IF(MONTH(NOW())<MONTH(d.`geboortedatum`),12-MONTH(d.`geboortedatum`)+MONTH(NOW()),IF(MONTH(NOW())=MONTH(d.`geboortedatum`) AND DAYOFMONTH(NOW())<DAYOFMONTH(d.`geboortedatum`),11,MONTH(NOW())-MONTH(d.`geboortedatum`)))),'mnd.'))) ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM creche_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id WHERE (r.creche_reservering_id = f.creche_reservering_id))
veld.label: Leeftijd

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(IF((SELECT COUNT(i.inenting_id) FROM lichaamelijk_inentingen AS li JOIN inentingen AS i ON i.inenting_id = li.inenting_id AND i.controle IS TRUE AND eind_datum <= NOW() WHERE li.lichaamelijk_id = d.lichaamelijk_id) > 0 OR (SELECT COUNT(li.inenting_id) FROM lichaamelijk_inentingen AS li WHERE li.lichaamelijk_id = d.lichaamelijk_id) = 0,'Nee','Ja') ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM creche_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id WHERE (r.creche_reservering_id = f.creche_reservering_id))
veld.label: Inentingen

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(concat(s.naam, ' - ', k.kennel_nummer) ORDER BY s.naam ASC, k.kennel_nummer ASC separator '; ') AS kennels FROM kennels AS k JOIN sectoren AS s ON k.sector_id = s.sector_id JOIN creche_reservering_regels AS r ON k.kennel_id = r.kennel_id WHERE (r.creche_reservering_id = f.creche_reservering_id))
veld.label: Kennel(s)
